title: India at Glasgow 2026 schedule tracker
scope: India-specific competition sessions based on the 126-athlete ministry-approved contingent.
timezone: All tracker times are converted to Indian Standard Time (IST). Glasgow is on BST; IST is 4 hours 30 minutes ahead.
scheduleEdition: Official Glasgow 2026 master event schedule published 13 July 2026.

rows.event: Women’s Pairs Sectional Play: India vs Malta
rows.sourceBasis: Official Glasgow 2026 Bowls & Para Bowls Match Schedule (13 July 2026)

result.summary: Rupa Rani Tirkey & Pinki Singh defeated Malta 18-9 in their opening Sectional Play match.
result.editorNote: The Indian pair took control midway through the match, securing a comfortable nine-shot victory over Malta.
